scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.eslint.json && npm run typecheck -w @platform/web && npm run typecheck -w @platform/script
scripts.lint: tsc -b packages/scoring packages/contracts && eslint . && npm run lint -w @platform/web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.dev: tsc -b packages/scoring packages/contracts && npm run dev -w @platform/api
scripts.dev:web: tsc -b packages/scoring packages/contracts && npm run dev -w @platform/web
scripts.dev:web:local: tsc -b packages/scoring packages/contracts && node scripts/WithEnv.ts node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev apps/web --port 3000
scripts.build:web: tsc -b packages/scoring packages/contracts && npm run build -w @platform/web
scripts.dev:script: tsc -b packages/scoring packages/contracts && npm run dev -w @platform/script
scripts.build:script: tsc -b packages/scoring packages/contracts && npm run build -w @platform/script
scripts.dev:discord: tsc -b packages/scoring packages/contracts && npm run dev -w @platform/discord
